title: No One-Size-Fits-All: Adaptive Code Editing with Feature-Based Strategy Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.22881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have shown strong potential in automating code editing (CE) tasks, yet most existing systems rely on a fixed CE strategy (i.e., one-step, search-replace, and plan-apply) across diverse scenarios. In practice, CE tasks vary widely in code context, edit locality, and semantic complexity, causing no single strategy to perform consistently well. Moreover, systematic studies on the relationship between strategies and CE tasks remain scarce, limiting further optimization of LLM-based code editing strategies. To address this gap, we construct CEBench, comprising 500 real-world CE tasks curated from SWE-bench. Then we compare three representative CE strategies (one-step, search-replace, plan-apply). translated_title: 没有一劳永逸的方案：基于特征策略选择的自适应代码编辑
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在自动化代码编辑（CE）任务中展现出强大潜力，但现有系统大多在各种场景下依赖固定的CE策略（即单步生成、搜索替换和计划应用）。在实践中，CE任务在代码上下文、编辑局部性和语义复杂性方面差异巨大，导致没有任何单一策略能够始终表现良好。此外，关于策略与CE任务之间关系的系统性研究仍然稀缺，限制了基于LLM的代码编辑策略的进一步优化。为填补这一空白，我们构建了CEBench，其中包含从SWE-bench中精选的500个真实世界CE任务。随后我们比较了三种代表性的CE策略（单步生成、搜索替换、计划应用）。我们的研究揭示了两个关键发现：（1）每种策略都针对特定的CE任务展现出独特优势，不存在普遍最优的策略；（2）策略的有效性受到四个核心任务特征的显著影响：总行（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了CEBench基准并系统对比三种代码编辑策略，发现没有任何单一策略在所有任务上都最优，策略效果显著受任务特征影响，因此代码编辑应根据任务特征自适应地选择编辑策略。
en_tdlr: This study constructs CEBench and systematically compares three code editing strategies, revealing that no single strategy is universally optimal—strategy effectiveness depends on task features, motivating adaptive strategy selection for code editing.
